verdict.rationale: Airwallex explicitly documents connected accounts for onboarding sellers/businesses (docs-1), Transfers/payouts to third parties (docs-12), and a multi-currency wallet for settlement (docs-11), covering the core marketplace flows of onboarding, splitting, and paying out. Docs also cover refunds, webhooks for event-driven reconciliation, and a sandbox for testing these flows end-to-end. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation or hands-on example of a 'split payment' primitive (e.g., percentage-based fee splitting across multiple connected accounts in a single transaction) and independent/third-party corroboration of marketplace use cases in production.
